deals.headline: Five Brainport companies lend PSV EUR 30m through Partnerfonds I
deals.investor: PSV Partnerfonds I: Philips, ASML, De Mandemakers Groep, BrandLoyalty and VDL Groep
deals.summary: Philips, ASML, De Mandemakers Groep, BrandLoyalty and VDL Groep together made EUR 30m available on equal terms at 1.5% interest, partly new money and partly refinancing of old loans, for investment at De Herdgang and the stadium and to strengthen equity. The annual report shows the subordinated loans at EUR 30m, due by 2032.

deals.evidence: De vijf partijen stellen PSV gezamenlijk direct een lening van dertig miljoen euro ter beschikking.
deals.headline: PSV raises a EUR 30m subordinated loan from five parties through Partnerfonds 2
deals.investor: PSV Partnerfonds 2: EDCO Eindhoven BV, Frank van Gool, Koninklijke Jumbo Foodgroep BV, Maarten Franken and Royal Swinkels Family Brewers
deals.summary: Three companies and two entrepreneurs lend PSV EUR 30m as a subordinated loan on the same terms as Partnerfonds I, for investment at the PSV campus and the Philips Stadion and for the football side. The 2024-25 annual report says 50% of the EUR 30m nominal was provided in 2021-22 (EUR 15m outstanding at 1.5%, repayments from 1 July 2032).

name: PSV
notes: Latest published accounts are 2024-2025 (year to 30 June 2025, signed 6 October 2025); the 2025-26 report was not yet on psv.nl on 2026-10-03. Figures are in EUR thousands in the report; net result EUR 7.548m. Stake percentages are not published: the foundation holds all shares but one special share. Capacity is the club's 'ruim 35.000' (more than 35,000). The club plans to expand the Philips Stadion to an expected 52,000-58,500 seats (works 2027-2030; intent agreement with the municipality signed 31 October 2025; financing still being worked out per psv.nl, March 2026). Social followers are the report's 2.2 million (another passage of the report gives 2.2 million for the Netherlands). No average attendance is given (more than 1 million spectators over 30 home matches). PSV's own 2022 release names Opportunity Partners rather than BrandLoyalty among the 2016 Partnerfonds I lenders. No valuation found on a citable page.

ownership_summary: PSV N.V. is held by Stichting PSV Voetbal, a foundation that has held the professional club since PSV N.V. was formed on 1 July 1999, except for one special share owned by the members' association Eindhovense Voetbalvereniging PSV (founded 1913 as Philips Sport Vereniging). Philips is the club's founder and a sponsor, not a shareholder. There are no private or institutional shareholders; outside money has come in as subordinated loans from regional companies (PSV Partnerfonds I in 2016, Partnerfonds 2 in 2022).
